narrative.overview: Kisan AI embodies the quiet, dependable authority of an agronomist's field station: crisp, scientific precision rooted in chlorophyll greens, warm loam earth, and daylight-clear contrast. Designed for smallholder farmers, extension officers, and rural entrepreneurs, the interface avoids the cold sterility of bureaucratic government portals and the glossy distractions of consumer SaaS. It feels warm, empathetic, conversational, and soft-spoken—treating farmers with dignity and profound respect.
keyCharacteristics: Chlorophyll & Loam Tonal Depth: Grounded in deep foliage greens (#047857, #064e3b) and warm loam earth tones (#1c1917, #292524).
Tactile and Grounded Materiality: Clean, flat-by-default cards bounded by delicate earth borders (#e7e5e4) that lift gently on interaction.
Multilingual Script Harmony: Uncompromised, native legibility for Indic scripts (Noto Sans Tamil, Noto Sans Devanagari) alongside Public Sans.
Zero-Ambiguity Regulatory Safety: Strict statutory hazard semantics separating life-critical pesticide alerts from routine cultivation advice.

rules.name: The Sunlight Contrast Rule
rules.body: Primary text (#1c1917) and secondary labels (#44403c) must always satisfy a contrast ratio of at least 7:1 against card backgrounds (#ffffff) and canvas surfaces to ensure effortless reading in harsh direct midday sun.

rules.name: The No-Ambiguity Alert Rule
rules.body: Red (#b91c1c) is strictly reserved for statutory chemical violations and safety warnings. It must never be used for standard system badges or design accents. Amber (#d97706) signals agronomic or weather caution. Green (#047857) denotes agronomically safe and CIBRC-approved practices.

rules.name: The Regional Script Parity Rule
rules.body: Indic script typography (Tamil and Hindi) must receive optical line-height adjustments (+15% line-height relative to Latin script) and never be rendered in artificially compressed font weights, preserving clear vowel diacritics.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat with clean 1px borders (#e7e5e4). Shadows are organic, green-tinted, and emerge only to communicate elevation, active state, or user interaction.

dos: Do maintain a minimum 44x44px clickable area for all interactive controls to support outdoor mobile field use.
Do format all monetary amounts as Rs. XX,XXX and land sizes with explicit acres units.
Do render regional script text (Tamil, Hindi) with adequate vertical padding to prevent glyph clipping.
Do cite authoritative sources (TNAU, ICAR, CIBRC) prominently in advisory cards.
donts: Don't use generic corporate blues or playful pastel gradients; honor the chlorophyll and loam identity.
Don't use red for generic UI accents or decorative states—red is strictly reserved for statutory chemical warnings.
Don't display speculative profit or yield claims in crop plans without explicit disclaimers.
Don't reduce body font sizes below 14px (0.875rem) anywhere on mobile viewports.
